translations.web: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men:
translations.bsb: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone—
translations.kjv: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
